name: Irish Chicken Fillet Roll

ingredients.name: Neutral oil, such as vegetable oil, for frying
soft baguettes rolls, sliced open lengthwise and warmed
Irish cheddar cheese, such as Kerrgold, shredded

instructions.primary_message: For the Sauce: In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire, and chili powder to combine; set aside.
For the Chicken: Set 3 wide, shallow bowls on a work surface. Add flour to the first one, beaten egg to the second, and panko to the third.

Season both sides of chicken cutlets with pepper and 3/4 teaspoon salt. Working with one at a time, dredge a cutlet in flour, shaking off excess. Transfer to egg dish, then turn cutlet to coat both sides. Lift and allow excess egg to drain off, then transfer to breadcrumbs. Gently scoop breadcrumbs on top of chicken and press, turning chicken to ensure an even layer of crumbs on both sides. Transfer breaded cutlet to a clean plate and repeat with remaining cutlet.

Fill a large cast iron skillet with 0.5 cm of oil. Heat oil over medium-high until shimmering and the temperature registers 375ºF (190ºC) on an instant-read thermometer. Carefully place breaded cutlets in oil and fry, gently rotating cutlets and adjusting heat as needed for even browning, until bottom side of cutlets are golden brown and crisp, 2 1/2 to 3 minutes. Flip and continue to fry until other side is browned and crisp, and chicken registers at least 71°C, 2 1/2 to 3 minutes longer. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt and let rest for 5 minutes to cool.

To Build the Sandwich: Spread butter evenly between both sides of each roll. Layer the bottom side of each roll with lettuce, red onion, and tomato. Slice chicken cutlets thinly on a bias and arrange 1 sliced cutlet on top of lettuce mixture to fill length of roll. Drizzle each cutlet with 2 tablespoons of taco sauce and top each evenly with cheese. Close sandwich and slice each roll in half crosswise. Serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: Irish Chicken Fillet Roll, fried chicken sandwich recipe, chicken sandwhich recipe

description: This Irish chicken fillet roll features crispy breaded chicken, sharp cheddar, lettuce, and a creamy homemade "taco sauce" on a soft buttered baguette.
notes:
Optional substitutions: soft baguettes rolls → long rolls

Notes: For a quicker, more convenient preparation, you can substitute store-bought frozen breaded chicken tenders or breaded cutlets for the homemade version. Cook them according to package directions in the oven, toaster oven, or air fryer until heated through and crisp before slicing and assembling the sandwiches.
Look for soft, deli or supermarket-style baguettes, which are often labeled "French bread."

Make-ahead and storage: The taco sauce can be made up to 5 days in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container.
The fried chicken cutlets can also be prepared up to 3 days ahead and refrigerated, though they will lose some crispness; reheat in a 220°C (425°F) oven or air fryer until hot and re-crisped before assembling sandwiches.
Assembled sandwiches are best enjoyed right away, but in a pinch can be refrigerated for up to 1 day; the bread will soften over time.
author: Leah Colins
